gemini-2.5-flash.exact_reserve_text: An overall strengthening of prior year's provisions for claims during the year of approximately GBP 0.3m (2013: release of GBP 32.3m) was primarily driven by the adverse experience on the Public Liability accounts in Third party liability, strengthening of GBP 20.8m (2013: strengthening of GBP 9.2m). This is offset by the favourable experience on Marine aviation and transport GBP 14.8m (2013: release of GBP 32.6m), Fire and other damage to property GBP 3.6m (2013: release of GBP 5.6m) and Pecuniary loss GBP 2.2m (2013: release of GBP 3.3m).
gemini-2.5-flash.standardized_narrative: The syndicate experienced an overall strengthening of prior year's claims provisions by approximately GBP 0.3 million in 2014. This was primarily due to adverse experience on Public Liability accounts, which saw a strengthening of GBP 20.8 million. This adverse development was largely offset by favourable experience in Marine aviation and transport, Fire and other damage to property, and Pecuniary loss accounts, which resulted in releases of GBP 14.8 million, GBP 3.6 million, and GBP 2.2 million respectively.
